title: A Blood Vessel Clue in Pregnancy Blood Pressure
paragraphs: Some women have a problem in pregnancy. It is called preeclampsia. Their blood pressure goes up.
Scientists in Manchester looked at tiny blood vessels. These vessels carry blood. They looked at women with and without this problem.
The vessels of sick women did not relax well. A small signal was weaker. The scientists want to find new medicines one day.
